title: Bun prune-lockfile executor
description: Create a package.json and bun.lock containing only the packages a project needs (for Docker and deployments).

outputPath.description: Directory that receives package.json and bun.lock. Defaults to the output of `buildTarget`.

buildTarget.description: Build target used to find the output directory. Defaults to `<project>:bun-build`.

exactVersions.description: Pin dependencies to the exact versions from the workspace bun.lock.
